Q: Do i need to create a separate factory class if I'm using HasFactory in my Laravel Model? A:

The HasFactory trait just tells the code that there should be a factory that it can use for that model. It does not create the factory for you. https://laravel.com/docs/master/eloquent-factories has more information on models and factories. Factories are not required, but they're great for testing and seeding in development.
